candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on subwords, syllables, and characters commonly found in Chinese proper nouns and geographic names.
The feature represents the global coronavirus pandemic, encompassing virus variants, vaccines, and societal impacts.
This feature vector represents common name components, suffixes, or geographical terms found in East Asian and international proper nouns.
This vector represents prominent political figures and associated geopolitical entities or current events.
These tokens represent calendar dates or days of the month.
This vector is related to prominent organizational, corporate, and regulatory acronyms or abbreviations.
This vector represents human beings and people-related terminology across multiple languages.
The tokens represent the root, morphological variants, and sub-word fragments of words related to society and science.
These tokens represent various countries and nations around the world.
